claim: Under the law 22-13 wording, annulment, interpretation and legality claims against decisions of central administrative authorities, national public bodies and national professional organisations go at first instance to the Administrative Appeal Court of Algiers, not to an administrative court chosen under articles 803 and 804. t30 fires on claim_challenges_administrative_decision and national_public_body_party but only offers the 803/804 places, and n3 tells the lawyer the territorial rule is 803 and 804.

source.what: Law 22-13 of 12 July 2022, inserting CPCA article 900 مكرر ¶3; OJ 2022 no. 48 (17 July 2022), PDF page 8 per the article store (read through the store text view, cpca 900 مكرر ¶3).

quoteArabic: وتختص المحكمة الإدارية للاستئناف للجزائر بالفصل كدرجة أولى في دعاوى إلغاء وتفسير وتقدير مشروعية القرارات الإدارية الصادرة عن السلطات الإدارية المركزية والهيئات العمومية الوطنية والمنظمات المهنية الوطنية.
consequence: For a claim challenging a decision of a central authority, a national public body or a national professional organisation, the record should name the Administrative Appeal Court of Algiers (from the installation date under law 22-13 art. 13) instead of the 803/804 court; filing at a local administrative court meets a public-order incompetence (807, applied to appeal courts by 900 مكرر 4).

claim: t30 lists only taxes, public works, administrative contracts, staff disputes and harmful acts from article 804, and leaves out ¶6 (medical services: court of the place where the services were given), ¶7 (supplies, works, technical or industrial services: place of the agreement or of performance only if a party resides there) and ¶9 (execution difficulties: president of the administrative court that gave the judgment). A malpractice claim against a public hospital is common; there the record's only medical rule is t22, which has no condition and names the ordinary court «and no other».

source.what: CPCA article 804 ¶6, ¶7, ¶9 in the law 22-13 wording; OJ 2022 no. 48, PDF page 5 per the article store (same words in the law 08-09 wording, OJ 2008 no. 21, PDF page 76).

quoteArabic: 5– في مادة الخدمات الطبية، أمام المحكمة التي يقع في دائرة اختصاصها مكان تقديم الخدمات، 6– في مادة التوريدات أو الأشغال أو تأجير خدمات فنية أو صناعية، أمام المحكمة التي يقع في دائرة اختصاصها مكان إبرام الاتفاق أو مكان تنفيذه إذا كان أحد الأطراف مقيما به،
consequence: t30 should carry all of article 804's mandatory places, and t22 should not present the ordinary court as the only court when the care was given by a public administrative body; the administrative supplies/works rule also differs from t7 (residence condition instead of «even if a party does not reside there»).

claim: The law on individual labour disputes, never repealed expressly (CPCA 1064 repeals only the 1966 code), makes the court of the plaintiff's residence an option («يمكن») when the employment relation was suspended or ended by a work accident or occupational illness, beside the place of performance and the defendant's residence. The record turns it into the court that has jurisdiction, «by way of exception» to the others, under article 40's «and no other»; a worker who sues at the workplace court in such a case is told he is at the wrong court.

source.what: Law 90-04 of 6 February 1990 on individual labour disputes, article 24 (under «الفرع الثاني: الاختصاص الإقليمي»); OJ 1990 no. 6 (7 February 1990), page 243 (PDF page 19), read on the page image. CPCA 1064 (OJ 2008 no. 21, PDF page 95 per store) repeals only ordinance 66-154. Not checked: whether law 91-28 later touched article 24.

quoteArabic: المادة 24 : ترفع الدعوى امام المحكمة الواقعة في مكان تنفيذ علاقة العمل او في محل اقامة المدعي عليه. كما يمكن رفعها لدى المحكمة التي تقع في محل اقامة المدعي عندما ينجم تعليق او انقطاع علاقة العمل عن حادث عمل او مرض مهني.
consequence: n6/t21 should not present the plaintiff's-domicile court as exclusive: the record should cite law 90-04 art. 24, show the plaintiff's residence as at least an added option in work-accident cases, and record the conflict between the special law's «may» and CPCA 40/501 (open point) instead of warning against the workplace or defendant's court.

claim: The regulation the record says is missing exists: executive decree 23-53 fixes twelve specialised commercial courts and their territorial districts, each covering several judicial councils (e.g. Algiers covers the councils of Algiers, Bouira, Tizi Ouzou and Boumerdès). The code's territorial rules (536 مكرر 1) therefore point to the council where the connecting place lies, and the decree maps it to one of twelve courts.

source.what: Executive decree 23-53 of 14 January 2023 fixing the territorial districts of the specialised commercial courts, articles 2 and 3 and annex; OJ 2023 no. 2 (15 January 2023), page 19, read on the page image (French edition F2023002.pdf p. 16 agrees).

quoteArabic: المادة 2 : يحدد عدد المحاكم التجارية المتخصصة باثنتي عشرة (12) محكمة عبر كامل التراب الوطني، تحدد دوائر اختصاصها الإقليمي طبقا للملحق المرفق بهذا المرسوم.
consequence: t12 and n10 should name the specialised commercial court from the decree's annex (court by council), and o5 should no longer say the regulation is absent; the installation date (law 22-13 art. 13) is still not found in the OJ issues read and stays a check for the lawyer.

claim: The special law on social-security disputes exists and was not read: it sends general disputes, after a mandatory prior internal recourse, to «the competent court under the Code of Civil Procedure» (so no separate venue rule), and sends disputes between public institutions and administrations acting as employers and the social-security bodies to the administrative courts.

source.what: Law 08-08 of 23 February 2008 on social-security disputes, articles 4, 15 and 16; OJ 2008 no. 11 (2 March 2008), pages 8-9, read on the page images (French edition F2008011.pdf p. 8 agrees).

quoteArabic: المادة 15 : تكون القرارات الصادرة عن اللجنة الوطنية المؤهلة للطعن المسبق قابلة للطعن فيها أمام المحكمة المختصة طبقا لأحكام قانون الإجراءات المدنية، ... المادة 16 : تختص الجهات القضائية الإدارية بالبت في الخلافات التي تنشأ بين المؤسسات والإدارات العمومية بصفتها هيئات مستخدمة وبين هيئات الضمان الاجتماعي.
consequence: k15/k52 should not read «searchedNotFound»: the record should cite law 08-08 (venue by the procedure code's rules, administrative courts for public-employer disputes, art. 4 prior recourse before any court claim) and o6 can be narrowed accordingly.

claim: Article 40 ¶3 gives «مواد الميراث» and article 498 gives «دعاوى التركة» to the court of the deceased's domicile, but t13 and n8 fire only on partition_of_estate. A common inheritance claim that is not a partition (an heir claiming his share or its income from a co-heir, annulment of a will or of a disposition made by the deceased, a claim against the estate) gets no estate rule, so the record falls back on t1 (defendant's domicile).

source.what: CPCA articles 40 ¶3 (PDF page 7) and 498 ¶1 (PDF page 41), law 08-09, OJ 2008 no. 21 (23 April 2008), per the article store; both quoted in the record (b11, b48).

quoteArabic: يؤول الاختصاص في دعاوى التركة إلى المحكمة التي يقع فيها موطن المتوفى، حتى وإن وجدت بعض أملاك التركة خارج دائرة الاختصاص الإقليمي لهذه المحكمة، ما لم ينص القانون على خلاف ذلك.
consequence: The estate rule (t13) and its warning should fire for any inheritance or estate claim, not only for a partition; with only partition_of_estate the record proposes the defendant's domicile where article 40 says «دون سواها».

target: n1, t1, b1, k23, k43, jurisdiction_clause_relied_on
claim: Article 37 itself gives jurisdiction to the court of an elected domicile, and the Civil Code says an elected domicile must be proved in writing and covers everything about the act, enforcement included, unless restricted. The record never asks whether a domicile was elected or in writing, and a contract clause electing domicile between non-traders (common in notarial deeds) would be answered «clause relied on: yes» and get n1's warning that it is void under article 45, although article 37 makes that court competent.

source.what: Civil Code (ordinance 75-58) article 39 ¶2-3, OJ 1975 no. 78, page 992 (PDF page 4), read on the page image; article 39 ¶1 replaced by law 05-10, OJ 2005 no. 44, page 21 (https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-arabe/2005/A2005044.pdf), which keeps the rest «بدون تغيير».

quoteArabic: يجب اثبات اختيار الموطن كتابة . الموطن المختار لتنفيذ تصرف قانوني يعد موطنا بالنسبة الى كل ما يتعلق بهذا التصرف بما في ذلك اجراءات التنفيذ الجبري مالم يشترط صراحة قصر هذا الموطن على تصرفات معينة .
consequence: The record should treat an elected domicile (in writing) as its own ground under article 37, distinct from a jurisdiction clause under article 45, and not warn that it is void between non-traders; it should also note the writing requirement and the act-limited scope.

claim: The Civil Code defines domicile and settles several cases the record leaves open: a legal person's domicile is the place of its management centre, and a company whose head office is abroad but which has activity in Algeria is deemed to have its seat in Algeria; a minor, an interdicted, missing or absent person has the domicile of his legal representative; the place where a person trades or exercises a craft is a special domicile for related transactions; with no dwelling, habitual residence stands for domicile.

source.what: Civil Code articles 37 and 50, OJ 1975 no. 78, page 992 (PDF page 4), read on the page image; articles 36 and 38 as replaced by law 05-10 arts. 19-20, OJ 2005 no. 44, page 21 (https://www.joradp.dz/FTP/jo-arabe/2005/A2005044.pdf). None of these articles is in the store.

quoteArabic: موطن وهو المكان الذي يوجد فيه مركز ادارتها . الشركات التي يكون مركزها الرئيسي في الخارج ولها نشاط في الجزائر يعتبر مركزها، في نظر القانون الداخلي في الجزائر . / المادة 38 : موطن القاصر والمحجور عليه والمفقود والغائب هو موطن من ينوب عن هؤلاء قانونا.
consequence: o8 can be answered from the OJ; k41 should give the management centre as a legal person's domicile; n2/o3 should not treat a foreign company active in Algeria as a defendant without an Algerian domicile; t1 should note the representative's domicile for a minor or interdicted defendant and the trade domicile for trade-related claims.

claim: The Commercial Code's commercial-lease chapter confirms the building's court but changes the judge and form for part of these claims: when the landlord accepts renewal and the dispute is about rent, term or conditions, the parties go before the president of the court of the building, who rules by the urgent-matters procedure by reasoned order; a tenant contesting a refusal of renewal must summon within three months of the refusal; the chapter's other claims are time-barred after two years. The record treats every commercial-lease claim as an ordinary petition to the property court.

source.what: Commercial Code (ordinance 75-59) articles 194, 195, 197 and 198, OJ 1975 no. 101, PDF pages 22-23 per the article store (read through the store text view, not on the page image).

quoteArabic: وجب على الطرفين الحضور أمام رئيس المحكمة المختصة، التي يكون موقع العمارة تابعا لها ، وذلك مهما كان مبلغ الايجار والذي يقوم بالبت فيها حسب الاجراء المقرر في قضايا الامور المستعجلة.
consequence: The territorial answer stands, but the record should cite the Commercial Code's own venue articles for commercial leases and flag that renewal-rent disputes go to the president of that court (urgent form), with the three-month and two-year limits for the court-sections and deadline modules.

claim: Divorce and return claims go to the court of the marital home, but two common situations have none in Algeria: divorce before consummation (the spouses never lived together) and couples whose marital home was abroad. The record's only family rule for divorce then names a place that does not exist or is outside Algeria, and it asks nothing about it.

source.what: CPCA articles 40 ¶3 (PDF page 7) and 426 ¶4 (PDF page 36), law 08-09, OJ 2008 no. 21, per the article store; both quoted in the record (b11, b38). No text read gives a fallback; the case is built from the texts.

quoteArabic: 3 - في موضوع الطلاق أو الرجوع بمكان وجود المسكن الزوجي، وفي الطلاق بالتراضي بمكان إقامة أحد الزوجين حسب اختيارهما.
consequence: The record should ask whether a marital home existed in Algeria and, when it did not, warn that article 426 ¶4 names no court and record the fallback as an open point instead of proposing the marital-home court.

claim: Before a claim is entered at a specialised commercial court, a conciliation before a judge named by its president is mandatory, and the petition must attach the non-conciliation record on pain of inadmissibility in form. The record sends claims to that court (t12, n10) without mentioning the step; it may belong to a prior-step module, but nothing in this record points to it.

source.what: CPCA article 536 مكرر 4 ¶1 and ¶3, inserted by law 22-13, OJ 2022 no. 48, per the article store (store text view).

quoteArabic: في حالة فشل محاولة الصلح، ترفع الدعوى أمام المحكمة التجارية المتخصصة بعريضة افتتاح الدعوى طبقا للقواعد المنصوص عليها في هذا القانون مرفقة، تحت طائلة عدم قبول الدعوى شكلا، بمحضر عدم الصلح.
consequence: n10's message should point to the mandatory conciliation and the attached non-conciliation record whenever it sends a claim to the specialised commercial court, or name the module that does.
